effects: Sets the share of the signer's total locked CELO delegated to `delegatee` for governance voting to `delegateFraction` (1e24 = 100%). This sets a new total. It does not add to the current share.
Moves governance voting power equal to totalLocked × fraction − currentAmount from the signer's account to the delegatee's account.

Resolves both the signer and the delegatee through Accounts.voteSignerToAccount. A vote signer therefore delegates the CELO of the account behind it, and the delegation goes to the account behind the delegatee address.
Adds the delegatee to the signer's delegatee set. The call reverts if the new share is lower than the current share, or if the total delegated share goes over 100%.
formats.shown: "Delegate" with the fraction as a percent (1e24 shows as 100%) and the delegatee address.

findings.title: delegateGovernanceVotes: 'Fraction to Delegate' reads as an added share, but the code sets a new total for the delegatee.
findings.evidence: LockedGold.sol delegateGovernanceVotes: `require(FixidityLib.gte(percentageToDelegate, currentDelegateeInfo.percentage), "Cannot decrease delegated amount - use revokeDelegatedGovernanceVotes.")` and `currentDelegateeInfo.percentage = percentageToDelegate;`. Descriptor field label: "Fraction to Delegate".
findings.fix: Change the label to "New total share of locked CELO" and the intent to "Delegate CELO governance votes".

findings.title: delegateGovernanceVotes: the intent "Delegate" does not name CELO governance votes or the base of the percent.
findings.evidence: Descriptor intent "Delegate". In LockedGold.sol delegateGovernanceVotes the amount is `FixidityLib.newFixed(totalLockedGold).multiply(percentageToDelegate)`, a share of the signer's total locked CELO.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Delegate CELO governance votes". Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Delegate {delegateFraction} of locked CELO votes to {delegatee}".

findings.title: delegateGovernanceVotes: the delegator and the delegatee are resolved through vote-signer mapping in storage.

effects: Takes msg.value CELO from the signer into the LockedGold contract.
Adds msg.value to the signer's nonvoting locked balance. The CELO is credited to msg.sender only.
Resyncs every existing delegation of the signer, so the new locked CELO is also delegated at the current shares.
formats.shown: "Lock CELO" with the native amount sent and the signer as Beneficiary.

findings.title: All formats: the deployment looks like a LockedGold implementation, not the proxy that signers call.
findings.evidence: meta.json: proxyResolution isProxy false, constructorArguments test=true. LockedGold.sol says `initialize` is "Used in place of the constructor to allow the contract to be upgradable via proxy". Initializable.sol: `if (!testingDeployment) { initialized = true; }`. On Celo mainnet, signers send LockedGold calls to the registry proxy (0x6cC083Aed9e3ebe302A6336dBC7c921C9f03349E). The descriptor binds 0x55E1A0C8f376964bd339167476063bFED7f213d5.
findings.fix: Bind the descriptor to the LockedGold proxy address that the Celo Registry returns, not to the implementation.

findings.title: lock: newly locked CELO is added to existing delegations at the current shares, and the screen does not say so.

effects: Moves `value` CELO from the signer's pending withdrawal at `index` back into the signer's nonvoting locked balance. No CELO moves out of the contract.
Deletes the pending withdrawal entry when `value` equals its full amount, otherwise reduces it.
Resyncs every existing delegation of the signer so the relocked CELO is delegated at the current shares.
formats.shown: "Relock" with the CELO amount, the signer as Beneficiary, and the index hidden.

findings.title: relock: the pending withdrawal index is hidden. It picks the source entry but does not change the amount.
findings.fix: Show `index` as "Pending withdrawal index" with format raw, and set the intent to "Relock unlocked CELO".

effects: Subtracts `revokeFraction` from the share of the signer's total locked CELO that is delegated to `delegatee`. The fraction is of total locked CELO, not of the delegation.
Removes governance voting power from the delegatee: min(totalLocked × fraction, currentAmount), or the full amount when the share reaches 0.
Can remove votes the delegatee already cast in referendums with the signer's delegated power.
Removes the delegatee from the signer's set when the share reaches zero.
formats.shown: "Revoke Delegation" with the delegatee address and the fraction as a percent.

findings.title: revokeDelegatedGovernanceVotes: 'Fraction to Revoke' is a share of total locked CELO, not of the delegation.
findings.evidence: LockedGold.sol revokeDelegatedGovernanceVotes: `currentDelegateeInfo.percentage = currentDelegateeInfo.percentage.subtract(percentageToRevoke);` and `FixidityLib.newFixed(totalLockedGold).multiply(percentageToRevoke)`. Descriptor label "Fraction to Revoke".
findings.fix: Change the label to "Share of locked CELO to revoke" and the intent to "Revoke CELO vote delegation".

findings.title: revokeDelegatedGovernanceVotes: can remove referendum votes the delegatee cast with the signer's power.

effects: Subtracts `value` from the signer's nonvoting locked CELO.
Creates a pending withdrawal of `value` CELO that is available after `unlockingPeriod`, a value in storage. No CELO reaches the signer in this call.
Reduces each delegation of the signer by value × share, which can remove referendum votes the delegatees cast.
Reverts if the CELO is used in referendum votes or is needed for a validator requirement.
formats.shown: "Unlock" with the CELO amount and the signer as Beneficiary.

findings.title: unlock: the intent "Unlock" does not say the CELO stays in the contract until the unlocking period ends and a withdraw call is made.
findings.evidence: LockedGold.sol unlock: `uint256 available = now.add(unlockingPeriod); account.pendingWithdrawals.push(PendingWithdrawal(value, available));`. Descriptor intent "Unlock".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Unlock CELO (withdraw after delay)".

findings.title: unlock: the signer's delegated CELO drops in proportion, and the screen shows no delegation effect.

effects: Sends the full CELO value of the signer's pending withdrawal at `index` to the signer (msg.sender). The amount is read from storage.
Deletes that pending withdrawal entry and moves the last entry into its index.
Reverts if the unlocking period of that entry has not passed.
formats.shown: "Withdraw CELO" with the signer as Beneficiary and the raw withdrawal index. No amount is shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the CELO amount received comes from storage, so the screen cannot show it.
findings.evidence: LockedGold.sol withdraw: `uint256 value = pendingWithdrawal.value; ... msg.sender.sendValue(value);`. Descriptor fields: only `@.from` and `index`.
